items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: And the SIDS Band was so different, because they had Slocum Williams.

ctx.x: West Indy. Mm-hmm. I wasn't sure Sip, but it probably came from New Orleans, and you're sure of that then? Yeah. He didn't come from his barn down that way. Yeah. Came out here real early and worked at the Barbary Coast.

Yeah, well, he worked all over. Yeah. And that's why I said he could have been here, or up in Canada, or somewhere. The band was called So Different. Mm-hmm. And I had the Spike Brothers and... I'll tell you last night. Mm-hmm. The Black and Tam Band, and they and themselves were so different. Did I tell you that? No, I don't remember who the Black and Tam? Yeah, they and themselves were so different. And the SIDS Band was so different, because they had Slocum Williams. He's from New Iberia, Slocum. He's dead. He…
